generation.seeds: 3101-3110 (B3 Gaussian draws); deterministic fixture seeds embedded per case

cases.description: M=I, b=e1+theta*e2, U=e1, theta=0: state exact but proxy derivative is zero while true derivative is e2.
notes: Explicit counterexample from Theorem 1 boundary note: exact state does NOT imply exact derivative under a fixed chart.
LS proxy derivative U*c_v = [0.+0.j 0.+0.j], true physical derivative t = [0.+0.j 1.+0.j].

cases.description: Well-conditioned complex n=6 system, r=3 fixed chart containing j and t: c_v matches FD and U*c_v reproduces t.
notes: j0,t0 placed in Ran U0; centered FD h=1e-6 on the fixed-chart LS coefficient.
zero-residual normal equation gives U*c_v=t as asserted by the theorem.

cases.description: Complex well-conditioned n=8 system, U fixed, j not in Ran U: correct LS coefficient derivative (with residual term) matches FD; omitted-residual formula is clearly worse.
notes: With residual r_s=b-C*c clearly nonzero, dropping (M_v U)^* r_s produces a wrong coefficient derivative; correct formula includes it.
Centered FD h=1e-6 used as reference.

cases.description: U(theta) depends on theta with zero residual at theta=0: moving-chart formula reproduces the finite-difference proxy state derivative while the fixed-chart formula is wrong.
notes: U(theta)=unit-normalized exact state, so proxy state is exact for every theta and residual is zero at theta=0 (residual actually zero throughout the ideal moving chart).
Fixed-chart formula (no U_v) fails; moving-chart formula C_v = M_v U0 + M0 U_v matches FD of U(theta)c(theta).

cases.description: R=5,T=4 complex H with |H_rt|>0.5: C(diag(a) H diag(b))=C(H).
notes: Cross ratio is invariant under diag(a) H diag(b) for arbitrary nonzero complex row/column gains (pure algebraic identity).
All H entries have magnitude >0.5; no denominators near zero.

cases.description: Recover row/column factors from H'_rt/H_rt and verify Q_rt=a_r b_t.
notes: a_r=Q_{r1}/Q_{11}, b_t=Q_{1t} recovers the factorized ratio Q_rt=a_r b_t.

cases.description: ker L = {E_rt=u_r+v_t}; SVD null space vs gain subspace distance.
notes: Complex-linear kernel of the linearized log cross-ratio operator is the R+T-1 dimensional row+column gain tangent subspace.
No realification here; this is the complex version of the quotient-projection identity used in 2D.

cases.description: Realified, whitened projector identity under non-identity covariance with cond(Sigma)=5.
notes: Whitened quotient projector L_w^T(L_w L_w^T)^{-1} L_w with L_w=L_R Sigma^{1/2} equals orthogonal projector onto complement of G_w=Sigma^{-1/2} G_R (G_R the realified gain subspace).
Sigma is a fixed SPD 2RT x 2RT matrix with condition number 5 and Sigma != I; matrix square root taken via symmetric eigendecomposition.
Algebraic identity only; no claim about finite-noise ratio sufficiency or nonlinear ratio statistics.

cases.description: H=u v^T: every cross ratio equals 1 within tolerance.
notes: H=u v^T gives all cross ratios exactly one: unknown separable row/column gains can absorb rank-one geometry variation.
This verifies the algebra; it does not imply any physics claim about scattering models.

cases.description: H=u v^T + eta s t^T satisfies the displayed closed form for C_rt-1.
notes: Closed-form two-component identity verified at machine precision with all entries and denominators safely nonzero.

cases.description: H with H_{2,1}=0 exactly: flag rather than blind division.
notes: Expected-fail control: cross-ratio routine returns the near-zero denominator flag instead of dividing blindly.
Only the flagging behavior is exercised; no division performed when any required denominator H_r1 or H_1t has |.|<1e-9.

cases.description: K=2,m=4: mu1=0, mu2=4 e1, beta=1, i*=1, worst-case e.
notes: Predictions and beta fixed before the 10000 independent Gaussian draws (seeds 3101..3110 x 1000).
Worst-case direction mismatch ||e||=beta toward candidate 2.
Empirical error 0.160800 <= bound 0.606531 + 0.03 (True); bound in [0.05,0.95] (True).

cases.description: K=3,m=4: mu1=0, mu2=4 e1, mu3=4 e2, beta=0.5, i*=1, e toward candidate 2.
notes: Conditional (branch in candidate library) positive case; candidates and beta frozen before validation noise.
Empirical error 0.091100 <= bound 0.649305 + 0.03 (True).

cases.description: K=3,m=4 same geometry, i*=2, beta=0.5, e toward candidate 1.
notes: Conditional positive case with i*=2 and e toward candidate 1.
Empirical error 0.068900 <= bound 0.391137 + 0.03 (True).

cases.description: Candidate library {0,4 e1}, true branch mean 2 e1, i* absent.
notes: Expected-fail control: true branch mean (2 e1) is NOT in the candidate library, so no selection can recover i* and the theorem bound does not apply.
Empirical error is 1.0 by definition, not by numerical accident.

cases.description: Candidate 1 fixed at 0 before noise; candidate 2 refit to y after seeing it.
notes: Expected-fail control: candidate 2 is refit to the validation observation y, so it is always selected and the empirical error is 1.0 while the candidate-1 truth never wins.
The plug-in bound evaluated with refitted d=||y|| is invalid because validation data were reused; the recorded average is the value one would wrongly quote after the fit.
With m=4 the average plug-in bound is about 0.69 (not near zero), but it is still below the conditional error 1.0, so quoting it would understate the error and the bound is demonstrably invalid.
No claim of a global coverage guarantee: conditional selection bounds are fixture-level only.

cases.description: Random well-conditioned complex M (n=8, sv in [1,5]) with arbitrary approximate adjoint.
notes: Complex identity q^*L(w-w_tilde)=p_tilde^*r+r_d^*M^{-1}r verified with conjugate-transpose adjoints on a cond~5 complex system.

cases.description: Resolvent-certified correction bound for the same B4 fixture.
notes: gamma=1/sigma_min(M) certified against ||M^{-1}||_2 computed from the exact offline SVD/inverse.
Post-correction bound |q^*L(w-w_tilde)-p_tilde^*r| <= gamma ||r_d|| ||r|| verified numerically.

cases.description: M=diag(1,eps), eps=1e-6: exact dual-residual identity values and resolvent quantities.
notes: All numerical identities pass: lhs=1, p_tilde^*r=0, r_d^*M^{-1}r=1, gamma=1/eps, certified bound = 1, exact adjoint p=M^{-*}L^*q recovers the error exactly.

cases.description: Small residual without resolvent control does not certify output accuracy.
notes: Expected-fail control: residual is tiny (eps) yet the true output error after p_tilde=0 correction is 1, so a small residual alone is NOT a certificate.
Certified bound equals the actual error in this equality case; the bound needs a verified resolvent gamma.
Exact adjoint p=M^{-*}L^*q does recover the error (numerical identity checked in 4C_identities).
